name: Fasting Blood Glucose
plain_summary: Measures the concentration of sugar circulating in the bloodstream following an overnight fast (typically 8–10 hours).

citation.excerpt: Normal fasting plasma glucose interval: 70–99 mg/dL in non-pregnant adults.

name: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c)
plain_summary: Shows the average percentage of red blood cells carrying glucose over the preceding 2 to 3 months, offering a longer-term picture than a daily blood check.

citation.excerpt: Normal HbA1c is below 5.7%. Values reflect average 3-month glycemic exposure.

name: Serum Creatinine
plain_summary: Creatinine is a standard compound formed from muscle turnover that healthy kidneys continuously filter and clear into urine.

citation.excerpt: Serum creatinine reference intervals typically span 0.7 to 1.3 mg/dL based on laboratory calibration.

name: Serum Potassium
plain_summary: Potassium is an essential mineral and electrolyte that helps nerves transmit signals and muscles (especially the heart) contract smoothly.

citation.excerpt: Adult reference interval for serum potassium is 3.5 to 5.0 mmol/L.

name: Hemoglobin (Hb)
plain_summary: Hemoglobin is the iron-rich protein in red blood cells responsible for carrying oxygen from the lungs to organs throughout the entire body.

citation.excerpt: Normal adult haemoglobin intervals typically span 12.0 to 16.0 g/dL.

name: Total Cholesterol
plain_summary: Measures total circulating sterol lipids in the bloodstream, encompassing HDL, LDL, and other lipid fractions.

citation.excerpt: Desirable adult total cholesterol is generally considered under 200 mg/dL.

name: HDL Cholesterol
plain_summary: High-Density Lipoprotein is often referred to as 'protective cholesterol' because it helps escort excess lipids back to the liver for disposal.

citation.excerpt: HDL levels above 40 mg/dL for men and 50 mg/dL for women support cardiovascular wellness.

name: Serum Triglycerides
plain_summary: Triglycerides are the most common type of fat stored from unused calories and circulated in the bloodstream.

citation.excerpt: Normal fasting triglyceride level is less than 150 mg/dL in adults.

name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
plain_summary: Produced by the pituitary gland to signal the thyroid gland how much metabolic hormone to synthesize.

citation.excerpt: Standard reference range for serum TSH spans approximately 0.45 to 4.5 mIU/L.

name: Platelet Count
plain_summary: Platelets are cellular fragments that help blood clot naturally to stem bleeding from minor cuts and vascular injuries.

citation.excerpt: Normal adult platelet count interval is 150,000 to 450,000 platelets per microliter.
